component.name: labelwerk
component.summary: Design and print labels on Brother QL printers

description.p: labelwerk designs and prints labels on Brother QL label printers under Linux – without the P-touch Editor and without Wine.

ul.li: Text with per-character formatting, images, symbols, barcodes and QR codes, decorative frames
Labels shown in real size, objects placed freely with snapping
Series from CSV/Excel or numbering, favourites, label files
Parcel labels (DHL, Hermes, Amazon returns) converted for 62 mm tape or 4×6" labels
PDFs and images printed 1:1, also from the command line

description.p: Tested with the QL-600; other QL models, Zebra printers (ZPL) and CUPS label printers should work but are untested.

screenshot.caption: A terminal label with text, QR code and frame
A return label converted for 62 mm tape
Drawing an own parcel label type

description.p: First public release: label editor, series, barcodes, symbols, parcel label converter, printer detection for the Brother QL family, Zebra (ZPL) and CUPS.
